title: Seville with family
text: Seville is charming and we really enjoyed learning a bit of its history. Zoraida is a very attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable guide regarding local history.  We really enjoyed the experience.
author: Maria_S

title: Zoraida is an excellent guide
text: We had an excellent experience, Zoraida gave us a tour with historical information, very clear and professional, she is very pleasant!! If you want to go to the cathedral and see the Santa Cruz neighborhood, I highly recommend going with Zoraida!!!
author: Diana_M

title: Visit Seville in 2 hours
text: Good morning from Betty and Guido (Italy) thanks to our guide, Ms. Zoraida, who was clearly kind and competent. until next time!!!

title: Closeness and a great experience
text:

author: 994josefernandor

title: A journey back in time
text:
We did a tour of the Giralda and the Real Alcázar of Seville and the experience was just amazing. From the beginning, our guide was wonderful: close, passionate and with impressive knowledge.

He did not simply explain historical data, but managed to transport us to another era, making us imagine what life was like in those centuries. Each corner came alive with its stories, anecdotes and curious details that made the tour very enjoyable and special.

Thanks to Zoraida , we not only saw monuments, but we felt the history of Seville in a unique way. Definitely a highly recommended experience if
author: Voyager49002051630

title: Friendly and Insightful tour
text:
Zoraida, our host was superb.
Originally the tour was to be conducted in Spanish only but because two of the couples were only English speakers, the whole tour was managed bilingual.
Friendly, insightful, a great way to see the Cathedral and the surrounding area.
Thank you
author: Dunk787

title: A most enjoyable guide
text:
Unforgettable. It was very pleasant, he told us a lot of details and anecdotes and the most remarkable thing was that he had to do it in two languages, always with a smile ahead.
I would repeat without a doubt!
